title: Real Time Software Systems and Microprocessors
description:
Prerequisite: ENMT322.
Restriction: Only open to students enrolled in the Mechatronics Engineering degree program at the Universities of Shady Grove. Timing, synchronization and data flow; parallel, serial, and analog interfaces with sensors and actuators; microprocessor system architecture; buses; direct memory access (DMA); interfacing considerations. System simulation in CAD.
